name: Mysterious Revelation (Gestalt)*
body:
You have a strange connection to divine energies, similar to an oracle, and a power has manifested from it.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, total of 9 ranks spent among the skills normally granted by the mystery (see below), character level 3rd.

Benefit: Select one oracle mystery. This mystery cannot be a mystery you already have. You gain one of the revelation powers for the selected mystery. For purposes of using that power, treat your oracle level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in oracle. You do not gain any of the other mystery abilities.

Special: You must have at least 9 ranks among the skills granted by the chosen mystery, and at least one of those skills must have at least 3 ranks (for example, you could select the Battle mystery if you had 3 ranks in Perception and 6 ranks divided among Intimidate, Knowledge [engineering], and Ride). For revelations that have a level requirement, your character level must be 2 higher than the level listed.

You may select this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you select the feat, it applies to a different revelation for the mystery chosen the first time this feat was taken.
